items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 6.12.5 at source lines 1929-1936: given c : prd a:A C a -> Q and p : prd b:B prd y:C(f b) (c(f b,y) = c(g b, D b y)), there is k : (Sigma w:W P(w)) -> Q with k(c-tilde'(a,x)) := c(a,x). The author's proof (source lines 1937-1955) gives a direct construction of the recursor rather than reusing the dependent lemma, and its coherence obligation is discharged by a three-step composite at lines 1949-1952 in which each step is a different fact: constancy of transport for the constant family Q, the hypothesis p(b,y), and the canonical identification trans (p b) y = D b y. The reformulation that makes the goal statable in the first place is thm:dpath-arrow at line 1940, and only the last line of the proof is the definitional computation rule.
